OnePlus DASH fast-charge microcontroller

Required properties:
- compatible: must be "microchip,oneplus_fastcg"
- reg: I2C slave address
- microchip,mcu-en-gpio: MCU enable GPIO
- microchip,usb-sw-1-gpio, microchip,usb-sw-2-gpio: USB path switch GPIOs
- microchip,ap-clk: application-processor clock GPIO
- microchip,ap-data: application-processor data and MCU interrupt GPIO
- pinctrl-names: must contain "mux_fastchg_active",
  "mux_fastchg_suspend", "mcu_data_active", and "mcu_data_suspend"
- pinctrl-0 through pinctrl-3: states corresponding to pinctrl-names

The driver obtains SNOC and CNOC update clocks from the MSM8998 RPM clock
controller.  They are intentionally not represented as consumer clocks in
the OnePlus board device tree.
